scripts.test:perf: npm run build -w backend && node scripts/performance/run-local.cjs
scripts.ai:check: npm run build -w backend && node scripts/check-local-ai.cjs
scripts.dev:ai: npm run ai:start && npm run dev
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run start:dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test:unit: npm run test -w @dashboard/data-core && npm run test:unit -w backend
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e:backend && npm run test:e2e:frontend
